top_signals.title: Bond Slide Grips Emerging Markets as Fed Risk Drags Sentiment
top_signals.summary: A global bond selloff spread to emerging markets as prospects for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike this month overshadowed the conflict in Iran and volatility tied to artificial intelligence as the main driver of sentiment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Kraken parent Payward to tokenize 100 London-listed stocks, with LSE 24 trading planned
top_signals.summary: Payward will tokenize 100 London-listed stocks as xStocks, with LSE 24 to support trading, subject to regulatory approval.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: NIB CEO Says Defense Project Pipeline Has Increased Rapidly
top_signals.summary: Nordic Investment Bank Chief Executive Officer André Küüsvek speaks on Bloomberg Television as the Helsinki-based multilateral lender owned by the five Nordic and three Baltic countries formally added resilience, security and defense into its strategy. "We are in discussions with around 30 other potential borrowers and counterparts with a gross pipeline of about €1.2 billion worth of projects today on the table," Küüsvek says. (Source: Bloomberg)
